name: Citizen
description: Individuals serving in a corporation, bureaucracy or industry, or who are making a new life on an untamed planet.

corporate.name: Corporate
corporate.description: You are an executive or manager in a large corporation.

worker.name: Worker
worker.description: You are a blue collar worker on an industrial world.

colonist.name: Colonist
colonist.description: You are building a new life on a recently settled world that still needs taming.

service_skills.name: Service Skills
service_skills.note: Use your assignment skill table for basic training, not service skills.

mishaps.1: Severely injured (treat as a result of 2 on the Injury Table). Alternatively, roll twice on the Injury Table and take the lower result.
mishaps.2: You are harassed and your life ruined by a criminal gang. Gain the gang as an enemy.
mishaps.3: Hard times caused by a lack of interstellar trade costs you your job. Lose one SOC.
mishaps.4: Your business is investigated by the planetary authorities (or your colony suffers interference from interests offworld). Co-operate and the business or colony is shut down but you gain DM+2 to the qualification roll for your next career as a reward for your aid. Refuse and gain an Ally.
mishaps.5: A revolution, attack or other unusual event throws your life into chaos, forcing you to leave the planet. Roll streetwise 8+. If you succeed, increase any skill you have by one level.
mishaps.6: Injured. Roll on the Injury Table.

events.2: Disaster! Roll on the Mishap Table, but you are not ejected from this career.
events.3: Political upheaval strikes your homeworld and you are caught up in the revolution. Gain either Advocate 1, Persuade 1, Explosives 1 or Streetwise 1. Roll whichever skill you chose 8+. If you succeed you come out on the winning side and gain DM+2 to your next advancement roll. Fail and you suffer DM-2 on your next Survival roll.
events.4: You spend time maintaining and using heavy vehicles, either as part of your job or as a hobby. Increase Mechanic, Drive, Electronics, Flyer or Engineer by one level.
events.5: You business expands, your corporation grows or the colony thrives. Gain DM+1 to any one Benefit roll.
events.6: You are given advanced training in a specialist field. Roll EDU 10+ to gain any one skill of your choice at level 1.
events.7: Life Event. Roll on the Life Events Table.
events.8: You learn something you should not have - a corporate secret, a political scandal - which you can profit from illegally. If you choose to do so, then you gain DM+1 to a benefit roll from this career and gain Streetwise 1, Deception 1 or a criminal Contact. If you refuse you gain nothing.
events.9: You are rewarded for your diligence or cunning. Gain DM+2 to your next advancement roll.
events.10: You gain experience in a technical field as a computer operator or surveyor. Increase Electronics or Engineer by one level.
events.11: You befriend a superior in the corporation or colony. Gain an Ally. Either gain Diplomat 1 or DM+4 to your next advancement roll thanks to their aid.
events.12: You rise to a position of power in your colony or corporation. You are automatically promoted.
